head: 복구 대상 9개 하천, 어디가 포함됐나
prompt: A wide shot of a flood-damaged rural stream in Gyeongbuk province, South Korea, taken from a low riverside embankment at golden-hour morning light. The riverbank shows collapsed concrete revetment blocks, exposed soil, and uprooted small trees along the water's edge. Muddy brown water still flows moderately fast. In the background, low mountains and a few rice paddies are visible. Shot with a slight telephoto compression, natural documentary photojournalism style, realistic textures, overcast diffused light, no people, no signage or text visible anywhere in frame.
alt: 경북 지역 호우로 제방과 호안이 무너지고 흙이 드러난 하천변 모습

head: 경북 의용소방대, 거제시 피해복구도 지원
prompt: A group of Korean men and women in orange volunteer fire brigade vests and rubber boots working together to clear debris and fallen branches from a flood-affected roadside ditch, photographed from a three-quarter angle at eye level in early morning soft daylight. They are using shovels and gloved hands, mud visible on the ground, damaged shrubs and scattered wood pieces around them. Background shows a residential town area with damp pavement. Documentary reportage photography style, natural light, shallow depth of field, no readable text or logos in frame.
alt: 주황색 조끼를 입은 의용소방대원들이 수해 현장에서 잔해물을 치우는 모습

head: 태풍철 앞두고 하천변 주민이 챙길 안전수칙
prompt: A Korean woman in casual outdoor clothing and a light rain jacket standing on a paved riverside walking path, looking cautiously at a swollen, fast-moving river below a low guardrail, photographed from behind and slightly to the side in overcast afternoon light before a storm. Dark gray clouds gather overhead, wind visibly bending nearby reeds and grass along the bank. She keeps a safe distance from the railing. Realistic candid photography, muted color palette, no visible text, signage, or gauge markings in the frame.
alt: 태풍을 앞두고 불어난 하천을 안전거리에서 지켜보는 주민의 모습
